class.name: NetwSyncKernel
class.brief_description: The payload a consumed [MultiplayerSynchronizer] frames its row through.
class.description: A consumed set has no declared schema, so its values self-describe and the caller supplies only the keys they land under. [code skip-lint]volatile [ordinal varint][reserved u8][values][/code] [code skip-lint]retained [ordinal varint][mask varint][values][/code] [constant RESERVED] is what keeps a volatile frame readable across versions: this grammar is the only one, so a sender that writes anything else there is speaking a newer one and its frame is refused rather than read against the wrong layout.

method.name: decode_retained
method.description: The values [param payload]'s mask marks present, read against the [param keys] the set bits select, and [code]null[/code] where the frame does not read against [param keys] at all.

method.name: decode_volatile
method.description: The values [param payload] states, and [code]null[/code] where the frame does not read against [param keys].

method.name: encode_retained
method.description: [param mask] names which of the set's watch fields [param values] carries, in ascending bit order.

method.name: encode_volatile
method.description: Frames [param ordinal] and [param values] as a volatile payload: [param values] self-describe, so nothing else names which fields they are.

constants.constant: The byte between a volatile frame's ordinal and its values. Every frame this version writes carries zero.
